The Illinois State Archives' Public Domain Land Tract Sales register enters this person 2 times, as “KING TUTHILL”, 1836-06-29: 2 lots in the platted town — the N2 of lot 5 of block 9 in the town the register codes CHI (N2L5BL9CHI, as printed); the S2 of lot 5 of block 9 in the town the register codes CHIV (S2L5BL9CHIV, as printed), 0.00 acres stated in all, for $2620.00 (ls1290, ls1291). THE TOWN LOTS ARE THE PLAT ITSELF, AND THEY ARE NOT ACRES: Cook County's register describes them by lot and block in a platted town and gives them no section, no township and no acreage at all, so they add nothing to the acre figure above and $2620.00 to the money.
